generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Period of completion 9 months (including monsoon.)

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, lab our, hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works, and all other incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the direction of Engineer in charge of this work.

The Tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer(District Level Officer)and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Certificate/Certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty first day of March of succeeding year(both days inclusive).

Each Tenderer should further demonstrate (a) As per this note, each tenderer should demonstrate availability of few key equipments / machinery for execution of the work. However as per Govt circular no GO FD.AE 263.EXP12.2022 dtd 11-05-2022, this clause for owning key equipments for works costing up to Rs.3.00 crores is exempted. However it is obligatory for the contractor to use the following machineries for various activities involved in construction as per Morth specification
The tenderer shall note that the scanned Documents can also be uploaded in the tasks created under Document/Evidence Required from the Bidder
The Employer reserves the right to Reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing e- procurement portal

Tenderer shall note that the Tenders of those found Eligible as mentioned in Clause 3 - Qualification of the Tenderer in Section 2 : Instructions to Tenderer I T T will only be considered for evaluation
To Qualify for award of this contract, each bidder should give all details and documents as per technical and financial bid attached to this tender
The bidders shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of each tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
All materials required for this work shall be procured by the bidder himself and should got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on the work.
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee into the respective receiving bank accounts of e- Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission

The increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of the contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.16.43 Lakhs. (Credit lines/letter of credit/ certificates from the banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. LOC in the prescribed Format-2 given in bid document.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately
The Tenderer should be a PWD Registered Class III & above contractor
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-3 KPWD and further orders thereon.

The Total EMD 1,09,540/- . Earnest Money Deposit shall be in two parts, Part (1) Rs.50,000/- by e- payment & Part (2) of the EMD.Rs.59,540/- by Bank Guarantee issued by Nationalized / Scheduled Bank. Contractor should upload the scanned Copy of Bank Guarantee issued by Nationalized/ Scheduled Bank. Original Bank Guarantee should be handed over by the bidders to THE EXECUTIVE ENGINEER, PWD, SIRSI DIVISION, SIRSI

Successful bidder should produce within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit for an amount equivalent to 5 % of the Contract price shall be deducted in every running bill. However, in case of first and final bill the entire security deposit will be deducted from the final bill and in any of the forms given below difference amount for below quoted tenders as additional security (for unbalanced tenders) in accordance with Clause 25.5 of ITT and Clause 44 of the Conditions of Contract
Any deviation / error / mistake found in units of items, they should be read as in the unified SR 2025-26 and the rates shall be quoted accordingly.
This Bid document clause no 34.4 to be implemented as per deligations of power vide GO No PWD423 FC-1 2018 banglore dated 24.09.2018
Star Rates may be regulated as per Government Circular No. PWD 159 CRM 2009 Bangalore Dated: 30.09.2010

If the rate quoted by the Successful Tenderer is less than the Amount put to tender, then the difference amount should be paid in the form of FDR / BG in favour of Executive Engineer, PWD Division Sirsi at the time of agreement.
Star rates are applicable

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 Up to date. Each Tenderer shall Executed in any one financial year, the following minimum quantities of the work, Construction of 1) Earthwork Excavation-263.36 Cum 2) Concrete (including PCC/RCC)-108.48 Cum 3) TMT Steel -5.21 Tonne 4) Plastering-610.93 Sqm 5) Tiles-421.98 Sqm 6) BBM/SSM/C C Solid Block/similar masonry wall-60.28 Cum

3.2 B) To qualify for award of this contract,each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22,2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as One Single Building work of value not less than Rs.27.39 Lakhs.

3.3 a. Each Tenderer should further demonstrate, As per this note, each tenderer should demonstrate availability of few key equipment/machinery for execution of the work. However as per Govt circular no GO-FD/AE 263/EXP-12/2022, Bangalore Dtd: 11.05.2022, this clause for owning key equipments for works costing up to Rs. 3.00 crores is exempted. However it is obligatory for the contractor to use the following machinery for various activities involved in construction as per Morth specification Excavator like JCB/Hitachi, Tippers, Road Roller(vibrator), PRR Roller , Paver finisher, Tractor Mounted Sprayer and 40/60TPH CAPACITY HMP

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified,if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity-( AxNx2.5-B )where A-Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N -Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited -0.75Year.B-Value at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 0.75 year (Period of completion of the works for which tenders are invited)
Annual Financial Turnover Certificate for the last five years i.e from 2021-22 to 2025-26,UDIN is preferred in Turnover certificate.
